wylie: lugs 'dir sgrib pa thams cad rigs bzhi'i sgrib par 'dus la, sgrib pa'i mtshan gzhir thig le de rnams bshad pa ni, thig le de rnams la gnas pa'i shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems rnams sgrib pa'i bag chags bgo gzhi yin pa la dgongs par gsungs so
english: In this system, all our spiritual obstacles are subsumed within the obstacles relating to these four types of drops.  The drops then are said to be the expression of these obstacles.  What this means is that the extremely subtle winds and thoughts which reside in these drops provide the foundation which is infected with the mental seeds of the obstacles.
